info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Scheduled Reports API
info.description: The ScheduledReports API lets you manage Scheduled Email reports, as well as generate, download or email any existing report.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to report on.
(Required) The report title shown in the UI and used in generated filenames. Truncated to 250 characters.
(Required) The delivery schedule for the report.
(Required) The hour of day (0–23) when the report should be sent.
(Required) The transport medium identifier, such as `'email'`.
(Required) The output format identifier, such as `'pdf'` or `'html'`.
(Required) The report unique IDs to include, e.g. `['VisitsSummary_get', 'Actions_get']`.

(Required) Transport-specific parameters, e.g. `['emailMe' => true, 'additionalEmails' => ['user@example.com']]` for email reports.
The saved segment ID to apply, or `false` for no segment filter.

(Required) The scheduled report ID to generate.

(Required) The date or date range to process. `'YYYY-MM-DD'`, magic keywords (`today`, `yesterday`, `lastWeek`, `lastMonth`, `lastYear`), or date range (e.g. `'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD'`, `lastX`, `previousX`).
The ISO language code to render the report in (e.g. `'en'`, `'de'`), or `false` to use the default language.

The output mode controlling how the generated report is delivered. Use `OUTPUT_DOWNLOAD` (browser download), `OUTPUT_SAVE_ON_DISK` (temp file for sending), `OUTPUT_INLINE` (browser inline display), or `OUTPUT_RETURN` (return contents as string). Defaults to `OUTPUT_DOWNLOAD`.
The data period to generate, or `false` to use the report's stored period.
The output format identifier (e.g. `'pdf'`, `'html'`), or `false` to use the stored format.
Transport-specific parameters to override for this generation, or `false` to use the stored parameters.
